// 4-digit BCD counter
module TopModule(input clk, input reset, output reg [2:0] ena, output reg [15:0] q);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            ena <= 3'b001;
            q <= 16'd0;
        end else begin
            case(ena)
                3'b001: begin ena <= 3'b010; q[3:0] <= 4'd0; end
                3'b010: begin ena <= 3'b011; q[3:0] <= 4'd1; if (q[3:0] == 4'd9) q[7:4] <= 4'd1; end
                3'b011: begin ena <= 3'b100; q[3:0] <= 4'd2; if (q[3:0] == 4'd9) q[7:4] <= 4'd2; end
                3'b100: begin ena <= 3'b101; q[3:0] <= 4'd3; if (q[3:0] == 4'd9) q[7:4] <= 4'd3; end
                3'b101: begin ena <= 3'b001; q[3:0] <= 4'd4; if (q[3:0] == 4'd9) begin q[7:4] <= 4'd4; q[11:8] <= 4'd1; end else if (q[7:4] == 4'd9) q[11:8] <= 4'd1; end
            endcase
            if (q[11:8] == 4'd9) q[15:12] <= 4'd1;
        end
    end
endmodule
